# CANDIDATE: DOUBLE_BOTTOM_ADJACENT_RECLAIM

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current double-bottom detector misses adjacent-low bars due to its strict local-low logic and empty `between` condition. By relaxing these conditions and adding a new `neckline` calculation, we can recover additional double-bottom patterns and potentially improve the overall performance of the detector.

## Mechanism

The proposed mechanism involves modifying the double-bottom detector to use a `min_separation_bars=1` condition and calculating the `neckline` as the maximum of the two lows. The `between` condition will be removed to allow for adjacent-low bars to be considered. The detector will then fire when a reclaim bar is detected above the `neckline`.
